title: Viewer
body: Load any ledgdex ledger and check every signature and hash in your browser. Keep your own ledger here too, sign messages to sellers, collect their receipts, and download your ledger as a complete dex. Nothing is uploaded: your key stays in this browser, and is stored only sealed with your passphrase.

title: About
body: Ledgdex is a simple market on a dex. Every self keeps a signed, append-only ledger in its own dex, and a trade exists three times: the buyer's signed claim, the seller's signed record of it, and the buyer's copy of that record.
The viewer verifies ledgers and keeps yours, in this browser. Its own pages, and the dex it downloads for you, are built the way dexweb builds them.
